name: Add & Commit
description: Automatically commit changes made in your workflow run directly to your repo

add.description: Arguments for the git add command

author_name.description: The name of the user that will be displayed as the author of the commit

author_email.description: The email of the user that will be displayed as the author of the commit

commit.description: Additional arguments for the git commit command

committer_name.description: The name of the custom committer you want to use

committer_email.description: The email of the custom committer you want to use

cwd.description: The directory where your repository is located. You should use actions/checkout first to set it up

default_author.description: How the action should fill missing author name or email.

fetch.description: Arguments for the git fetch command (if 'false', the action won't fetch the repo)

new_branch.description: The name of the branch to create.

pathspec_error_handling.description: The way the action should handle pathspec errors from the add and remove commands.

pull.description: Arguments for the git pull command. By default, the action does not pull.

push.description: Whether to push the commit and, if any, its tags to the repo. It can also be used to set the git push arguments (more info in the README)

remove.description: Arguments for the git rm command

tag.description: Arguments for the git tag command (the tag name always needs to be the first word not preceded by a hyphen)

tag_push.description: Arguments for the git push --tags command (any additional argument will be added after --tags)

github_token.description: The token used to make requests to the GitHub API. It's NOT used to make commits and should not be changed.
